title: Lingguang Open Ecosystem Expands Further: Adds 7 Connectivity Capabilities Including WeCom and Tencent Docs, Bringing Total Supported External Services to 54
excerpt: Recently, Lingguang, the AI assistant owned by Ant Group, announced another expansion of its open ecosystem, adding seven new external connection capabilities,
content_html:
Recently, Lingguang, the AI assistant owned by Ant Group, announced another expansion of its open ecosystem, adding seven new external connection capabilities, including WeCom, Tencent Docs, Tencent Meeting, and VariFlight. With this, the external services and connection capabilities supported by Lingguang have increased from 47 to 54, further expanding the service boundaries of the AI assistant across scenarios such as personal life, office collaboration, and business travel.

The newly added capabilities further cover users' high-frequency daily needs. In personal life scenarios, Lingguang has added photo album connection capability and, through Shortcuts, supports system operations such as changing wallpaper and Notes, promoting deeper integration between AI and native phone functions; in office scenarios, the addition of WeCom, Tencent Docs, and Tencent Meeting further enriches Lingguang's service capabilities in enterprise communication, document collaboration, and meeting management; in travel scenarios, the integration of VariFlight provides users with more convenience in obtaining travel information such as flight status.

Competition among AI assistants is shifting from model capabilities and conversational experience to task hosting in real-world scenarios. For next-generation AI applications, whether they can break down barriers between different platforms and services will directly affect the practical value and user experience of AI assistants. Connectors are not only an extension of AI capabilities, but also key infrastructure that drives AI from "answering questions" to "hosting tasks."

Previously, Lingguang integrated services such as DingTalk, Feishu, and WeChat Reading. Now, with the addition of enterprise collaboration, system operation, and flight service capabilities, Lingguang is continuing to expand the coverage of its open ecosystem. In the future, as more services are integrated, Lingguang is expected to further connect task chains across applications and scenarios, enabling AI to gradually grow from a single intelligent tool into a personal intelligent partner that can understand needs, connect services, and assist with execution.

Lingguang is a personal AI assistant launched by Ant Group and completed its 2.0 upgrade on October 27. Lingguang 2.0 takes task hosting as its core competitiveness. As of November 11, Lingguang 2.0 had hosted a cumulative total of more than 3 million tasks and executed more than 11 million tasks. It is reported that this metric is also being regarded by the industry as the North Star metric for personal AI agents.
